Select IC50 activity records with provenance for dapagliflozin and its salt forms against sodium/glucose cotransporter 1. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent dapagliflozin (CHEMBL429910) to retrieve all related forms. Retrieve activity provenance using the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Filter for standard_type IC50 and target CHEMBL4979. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to include canonical_smiles. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
